messages:
mo_fin: Heads-up: INV-9012 (GreenGrid) payment failed  issuer returned BIN-country mismatch, preauth declined. Customer needs access this afternoon for a demo.

jena_sales: On it with the customer. They report the card is corporate, issued in NL, billing address US. Can we accept alternate payment quickly?

ravi_ops: Decline payload: gateway=Stripe, decline_code=bin_country_mismatch, attempt=at_236482. Preauth never succeeded.

mo_fin: Short-term options: 1) secure one-click payment link for a different card, 2) accept manual wire, 3) Plaid Instant ACH if they have US bank. Which is fastest?

kai_support: Customer prefers not to do a wire. They can ask cardholder to update billing country but that's slow. They said they can do Plaid or enter a different card via a secure link.

jena_sales: Send the secure link and Plaid option. Also offer to pause onboarding until payment clears and waive any manual fees. We'll escalate if they push back.

payments-bot: Auto-retry scheduled in 24h (rty_236482). Recommend pausing retries if taking manual route to avoid duplicate charges.

mo_fin: Pausing auto-retry now. Kai, please send both links and ask for PO upload for reconciliation. Include wire as last resort and bank reference INV-9012.

kai_support: Drafted message and sent: "Hi  please choose one of these payment options for INV-9012: 1) Secure card entry: https://payments.redwood.ai/collect/oneoff/INV-9012 (valid 60m), 2) Plaid Instant ACH: https://payments.redwood.ai/collect/plaid/INV-9012. If neither works, we can provide wire instructions; please upload PO/company docs here: https://support.redwood.ai/portal/upload." Customer replied: "I'll use Plaid now."

ravi_ops: Action items: 1) add a telemetry flag for BIN-country mismatch events, 2) add invoice UI hint when billing country != card-issuing country, 3) review retry timing to avoid preauth expiry.

mo_fin: Thanks team. Leave invoice on hold until Plaid settles; mark paid after settlement and re-enable onboarding. :thumbsup:
